result.description: The Frostline Ember is a fictional compact portable storage enclosure designed for field logging, media shuttle, and backup workflows. It pairs a USB 3.2 Gen 2 interface with an internal NVMe M.2 slot, supporting up to 2TB of installed flash storage in a lightweight aluminum shell. A low-profile thermal pad and vented case help sustain transfer performance during long copy sessions, while the bus-powered design makes it easy to carry between workstations and laptops.
result.title: Frostline Ember 2TB Portable NVMe Enclosure USB 3.2 Gen 2
